source: due2-native: a date right operand with a timezone (decisions/0024, #116)
notes: The policy is valid ODRL 2.2 and passes odrl22-shape.ttl; the rejection is due2's. XSD allows a timezone on an xsd:date, but due2 admits a date only without one, so that dates are totally ordered (due2-profiles.md §4, decisions/0024). A policy that means a day in a given zone uses an operand whose range is xsd:dateTime instead: on or before 31 December 2026 in +01:00 is lt 2026-12-31T23:00:00Z, the instant that day ends.

expected_rejection.why: The right operand "2026-12-31+01:00"^^xsd:date of ex:publicationDate's constraint has a timezone. A date right operand has none (due2-profiles.md §4, decisions/0024), so W1 rejects the policy in stage 2.
